label: Box
depicts: Open box outline with two top flaps above a square front panel
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple open carton with visible top flaps.
avoid_when: Do not use for closed cubes or bins when the two open flaps should stay visible.

label: Box
depicts: Storage box outline with a top lid band and a centered dash label
use_when: Use when the interface wants a closed storage box with a lid strip and front label.
avoid_when: Do not use for open cartons when the flat top lid and front mark matter.

label: Box
depicts: Isometric cube outline with three visible faces and sharp outer edges
use_when: Use when the interface wants a three dimensional cube style box instead of a front view container.
avoid_when: Do not use for flat front view boxes when the angled cube faces are the key cue.

label: Box
depicts: Open bin outline with two tall inner panels rising above the rim
use_when: Use when the interface wants a box shaped container with two tall inner tabs or dividers.
avoid_when: Do not use for cube or flap boxes when the two inner panels are the visible distinction.

label: Basket
depicts: Shopping basket outline with an arched handle and two inner slot marks
use_when: Use when the interface wants a hand basket shape instead of a box or bin container.
avoid_when: Do not use for trays or boxes when the arched handle and inner slots matter.
